decision: Selected the planar centroid of Ministry of Justice registry-map parcel 京田辺市多々羅字西平川原39-16 (AIGID 2026 open-data conversion) as the campus locator for EdgeConneX's Greater Osaka campus (ITM01, Kagoya Tatara Campus), replacing the imported Kyotanabe city point. Kyoto Prefecture's published specified-building plan no. 665 gives the site of カゴヤ多々羅キャンパス（申請建物1） as part of this lot.
layer: AIGID conversion of the Ministry of Justice registry map (登記所備付地図) for Kyotanabe City, 2026 edition, GeoJSON in CRS84 (73,580 parcel features); filtered to 大字名 = 多々羅, 小字名 = 西平川原, 地番 = 39-16 (exactly one feature). Area and centroid computed in JGD2011 / Japan Plane Rectangular CS VI (EPSG:6674) and the centroid transformed back to WGS84 longitude/latitude with pyproj 3.7.1 and shapely 2.1.1.

kyoto_plan_665.building: カゴヤ多々羅キャンパス（申請建物1）
kyoto_plan_665.filer: カゴヤ・アセットマネジメント株式会社 (Kyotanabe)
kyoto_plan_665.location: 京都府京田辺市多々羅西平川原39-16の一部

exclusions: The point is the centroid of the whole lot 39-16; the 3.44 ha building-1 site is an unlocated part of it, and the 130,000 sq m campus may also take in the adjoining lot 39-20, which no source names. Lot 39-20 and the other touching lots are not used. No geocoder, map viewport, map-service coordinate or city centroid is used; the Kyotanabe mayor's quote in the EdgeConneX release is used only for the campus name.
